data_notes: Values are numerical weather model output (current conditions and forecasts), not guaranteed physical weather-station observations.
Coordinates are snapped by the provider to the nearest model grid cell; see returned_grid_location.
Hourly precipitation/rain values are sums over the preceding hour.

requested_location.description: Cauvery River near Upper Anicut, Tamil Nadu, India

rainfall_accumulation.method: Sum of hourly values whose hour ended at or before reference_time. Each window requires every hour to be present and non-null; otherwise the total is UNAVAILABLE. Future forecast hours are excluded.
